sources.title: Users of the world, unite! The challenges and opportunities of social media

concepts.definition: The planned use of social platforms to achieve business or professional goals.
Systematic monitoring of conversations about a brand, competitors and topics.
A following on a platform that owns the relationship and can change reach or rules.

questions.q: Why has the follower count become a weaker measure of reach?
questions.a: Platforms recommend content from accounts users do not follow and show each post to only part of the followers.

questions.q: How many platforms should a small business start with, and how should it choose?
questions.a: One or two, chosen by where the audience spends time and which formats the team can produce well.

questions.q: Compare organic and paid social media.
questions.a: Organic builds trust slowly at low money cost but high time cost; paid gives speed and targeting at a cost and stops with the budget.
